candidates.title: adoption_companion_pledge_screen
candidates.change: Adds a companion pledge sign-off screen immediately after picking a pet to build emotional commitment before photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest funnel drop-off at 39.1% (60.9% conversion). An explicit commitment pledge anchors user interest before higher-friction steps.

new_companion_pledge.headline: Make the Companion Pledge
new_companion_pledge.body: Promise to give your new desktop buddy a warm digital home on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new companion pledge screen inside onboarding without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but requires new screen (cost 0). Single prior test showed +1.5%.

candidates.title: pick_friend_two_column_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a side-by-side two-column layout displaying pet stats alongside pet choices.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops significantly to 60.9%; a structured two-column layout lets users compare companion traits without endless scrolling.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare companion personality traits and appearance side-by-side.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend layout while preserving pet selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 39.1%, but UI redesigns across other steps have consistently underperformed.

candidates.title: choose_path_story_scroll_flow
candidates.change: Converts path selection into a story scroll layout that guides users through pet behavior archetypes as they scroll down.
candidates.why: choose_path has a mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off, showing users take long to decide without visual context.

choose_path.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary
choose_path.body: Scroll down to explore how desktop companions live, work, and relax alongside your apps.

guard.reason: Choose path screen loses its required job of offering both adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: waiting_centered_stage_redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen into a focused stage layout centered around the pet hatching animation.
candidates.why: The home wait step has a median duration of 201s and 18.7% drop-off; a centered stage format maintains visual focus during generation.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Arriving
waiting.body: Setting up your companion's desktop environment and initial behaviors.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen while continuing to show that the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop-off is low (18.7%). Prior home redesign test yielded slight +0.7% lift.

candidates.title: sign_in_account_recovery_hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear hint reassuring users that signing in restores prior pets and syncs existing profile data across devices.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again, making explicit account recovery reassurance essential.

sign_in.hint: Signing in restores your existing pets, custom progress, and desktop settings automatically.

guard.reason: Adds an account restoration hint on sign-in without breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence with 8 support emails. Low cost text hint change; sign_in hint previously yielded +1.2%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your desktop pet is now live and exploring your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro with a full-bleed layout while keeping its onboarding function.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off (35.2%), but finish layout changes averaged -1.9% across 2 tests.

waiting.hint: You'll receive a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s mean). Notification changes have limited test history.
